8.6.3.15 DiagnosticMonitor
[SWS_Dem_00598] Definition of ClientServerInterface DiagnosticMonitor ⌈
Name
DiagnosticMonitor
Comment
Provide the capability to modify the event information. One port of this interface type is
provided per application-related diagnostic event by the Dem Service Component. It has Event
Id as a port-defined argument.
IsService
true
Variation
(({Dem/DemGeneral/DemStorageCondition.DemStorageConditionReplacementEvent
Ref})!=({Dem/DemConfigSet/DemEventParameter}) && ({Dem/DemConfigSet/DemEvent
Parameter/DemEventReportingType} == STANDARD_REPORTING))
0
E_OK
Operation successful
Possible Errors
